title: Execute the approved private zero-cost Vault TLS foundation
classification_reason: causes controller-managed CA and TLS Secret creation
expected_outcome: The approved private ECR repositories contain the verified cert-manager chart and four pinned images; cert-manager is Ready through the private EKS path; controller-managed Vault-only Certificates are Ready; vault/vault-tls exists with only its expected key names verified; and the Vault ingress NetworkPolicy is present without public reachability or Secret-data access.
constraints: Use only account 106760547719, EKS cluster node-operator, the existing private ECR foundation, and the existing private SSM EKS path.
Do not create or use AWS Private CA, public endpoint, NAT, Internet gateway, LoadBalancer, public DNS, or public egress fallback.

Apply only a fresh saved Terraform plan whose changes are exactly the two cert-manager private ECR repositories and their lifecycle policies plus any required policy/role scope extension for those repositories; stop if any other action appears.
Run only the checked-in signed chart mirror workflow and four checked-in digest-allowlisted image mirror dispatches; verify their non-sensitive digest results.
Install only cert-manager v1.21.1 from private ECR in namespace cert-manager, then apply only the checked-in Vault TLS and ingress policy manifests.

Only cert-manager may create or update its CA-key Secret and vault/vault-tls. Do not manually create, read, print, copy, commit, or log Secret data or private keys. Verify only object names, type-independent key names, and readiness conditions.
Do not initialize or unseal Vault; do not deploy workloads; do not label a Vault client namespace/workload; do not perform a TLS reload test; do not merge.

authorization.user_approval: User explicitly approved actual execution on 2026-09-04 after reviewing the zero-additional-AWS-cost internal-CA approach and its execution sequence.
external_actions: push the reviewed execution commit to the configured repository branch solely to make the reviewed mirror workflows dispatchable
create exactly the approved private cert-manager ECR runtime and Helm-chart repositories plus their lifecycle policies through a fresh allowlisted Terraform saved plan
dispatch the reviewed cert-manager chart mirror workflow and exactly four reviewed image mirror workflow runs, then read their non-sensitive status and digest summaries
install the approved private cert-manager Helm release in namespace cert-manager through the private EKS path
apply the reviewed Vault-only Issuer/Certificate and ingress NetworkPolicy manifests
read non-sensitive AWS, GitHub workflow, Kubernetes object metadata, Certificate readiness conditions, deployment readiness, and Secret key names

primary_owner.responsibility: saved-plan gate, private-path security boundary, live integration, and evidence

delegations.escalation_trigger: any unallowlisted cloud/Kubernetes action or public path

validation: GitHub mirror workflow success and ECR digest verification
